participation.context: Named four-and-twenty against fourteen, and would pull the house down before paying to have the clause read.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Refused to call it a bargain, and sent you to be Navarre.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked the length, and would not carry an unread clause into the yard.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Put the timber ahead of the curse, and kept the king's purse off Navarre's.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Offered a long king, cursed nobody, and agreed nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the figure is said, and no term is taken
relations.quote: Allen was civil. He named four-and-twenty pound a year.

story.body: James said the price and the unread clause. You offered a long king and no term. The curse was not said. You went on as Navarre.

title: Heard four-and-twenty pound and offered a long king
